# Open Mainframe Project

> A Linux Foundation initiative fostering open-source innovation, community collaboration, and modernization of mainframe computing through projects like Zowe, Galasa, and Linux on Z.

The Open Mainframe Project serves as a hub for enterprise mainframe modernization, bridging traditional z/OS systems with contemporary DevOps, cloud-native technologies, and open-source development practices. The project brings together industry leaders, developers, and organizations to advance mainframe accessibility and innovation.

## Key Topics

- Open Mainframe Project
- z/OS
- Linux on Z

## Core Projects

- [Zowe](https://openmainframeproject.org/projects/zowe): Zowe framework for z/OS modernization, DevOps, and CLI-AI integration
- [Galasa](https://openmainframeproject.org/projects/galasa): Galasa integration testing framework for z/OS and hybrid cloud DevOps
- [Ambitus](https://openmainframeproject.org/projects/ambitus): Ambitus containerization and developer education for IBM Z and Linux on Z
- [zopen Community](https://openmainframeproject.org/projects/zopen-community): zopen community expanding open-source tools and DevOps for z/OS platform
- [Tessia](https://openmainframeproject.org/projects/tessia): Tessia infrastructure automation for Linux installation and Z platform deployment
- [CBT Tape](https://openmainframeproject.org/projects/cbt-tape): CBT Tape free utilities for MVS, OS/390, and z/OS mainframe systems
- [Software Discovery Tool](https://openmainframeproject.org/projects/software-discovery-tool): Developer tool for discovering open-source software on z Systems
- [Our Projects](https://openmainframeproject.org/our-projects): Directory of open-source mainframe projects including z/OS and Linux tools

## Working Groups & Special Initiatives

- [Linux Distributions](https://openmainframeproject.org/our-projects/working-groups/linux-distributions): Linux distributions working group for s390x architecture and mainframe ports
- [OpenTelemetry Special Interest Group](https://openmainframeproject.org/our-projects/working-groups/opentelemetry-sig): OpenTelemetry SIG for mainframe observability and CNCF integration
